title: Yellowed Caramelized Uruguayan Tuna Skewers
description: A fatty and tender Uruguayan dish featuring caramelized tuna, perfect for a date night, and flexitarian-friendly. This recipe combines the richness of tuna with the sweetness of caramelized onions and bell peppers.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the tuna steaks to the marinade and coat evenly, letting it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated tuna onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the tuna skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Meanwhile, caramelize the onions and bell peppers in a large skillet over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until they are dark golden brown and tender.
Brush the caramelized onions and bell peppers with lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the grilled tuna skewers with the caramelized onions and bell peppers, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Slice the tuna skewers into bite-sized pieces and serve immediately.
